_comment: Seed list of firm careers pages, for deriving ATS boards the tracker can poll.
Why it exists: the live registry is 34 Greenhouse + 11 Ashby + 3 Workday, and
Greenhouse and Ashby are what tech companies and prop shops use. That is why a
finance careers tracker came back 72% software engineering. Banks and funds sit
on Workday, Oracle and bespoke sites, so they have to be found deliberately.
Most rows carry no tenant yet: 'Derive and validate' means the careers URL is
confirmed but the board behind it has not been resolved. scripts/discover-ats.mjs
does that resolution in CI, where there is network. Nothing here is guessed —
a tenant is only written once a board has answered with real postings.
